function.name: npc_ci_check_availability
function.description: Check open appointment times with NPC Services. Always call this before offering or booking any time. Put what the caller wants to book, in their own words, in booking_intent_text, and the day or time they asked for in preferred_date_text. The result gives intent_index, available_slots (each with startTime and endTime) and a message telling you what to say. Offer only times from available_slots, never invent one. If needs_clarification is true, ask clarification_question and call again.

booking_intent_text.description: What the caller wants to book, in their words, including phone or Zoom if they said so.

appointment_type.description: Only when the type is already confirmed. Leave empty if unsure; the tool classifies booking_intent_text.

preferred_date_text.description: The day or time the caller asked for, in their words, e.g. 'next Tuesday afternoon'. Empty if none.

earliest_time.description: Earliest local start the caller accepts, 24-hour HH:MM. Optional.

latest_time.description: Latest local time the caller accepts, 24-hour HH:MM. Optional.

search_reason.description: Why you are searching (first search, caller rejected the offered times, re-check before booking).

caller_context.description: Short context about the caller relevant to the booking.

startDateMs.description: Optional. Unix milliseconds of the day to search, used only when preferred_date_text names no date.

messages.content: Let me check the available times for you.
